selection: First five lexicographic mp4/avi files per category and source folder; no subject-disjoint guarantee
metrics: Target clip success: at least 3 consecutive correct outputs; negative success: no 3 consecutive target outputs. Also report any wrong accepted label. Includes startup, no frame accuracy claim.
limitations: No lateral-raise clips in this dataset selection.
No phone footage, no subject-disjoint guarantee; folder selections may share sources.
2 Hz ideal sampling omits network variability.
Pose/rule scores are not calibrated probabilities.
